articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
articles.snippet: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

articles.title: The data proves it: Bitcoin doesn't care about rising bond yields over long-term
articles.snippet: Long-term, BTC ignores rising bond yields. In the short term, however, surging bond volatility could easily dampen crypto's animal spirits.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $347M as BTC falls below $84K after topping $87K
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $347 million on Wednesday as Bitcoin fell below $84,000, while five-day inflows reached $2.65 billion.
